hypothesis.primary: A model must decode the observed resulting fifth-probe state (not the raw signed change), center it against a FIT-only selected-probe baseline, select the tagged causal B consequence rather than its cancelling decoy, and compose these two observed quantities to learn the correct later action.
hypothesis.negative: If a learned reader does not improve heldout FIT, causal tag erasure/uniforming does not hurt it, or one seed fails, the claimed causal-memory mechanism is not established.
hypothesis.native_specific: Native advantage is assessed only as an incremental ablation over a matched history-only reader; the scriptable physical decoder is a correctness ceiling, so Native is never claimed superior to a zero-regret deterministic control.

source.cue_decoy_positions: distinct SHA-256-derived positions per split and group, never model-visible
source.B_encoding: _record(tag, selected_action, tag+delta, context), mask reward effect[4]=0 in all B records; selected physical delta effect[0] and observable public key remain
source.fifth: Each selected probe action equals public context. The resulting-state q offset is identifiable from FIT-balanced selected fifth outcomes with opposite unknown q signs; do not require an unperformed or unauthorized nonmatching fifth action.
source.return_goal: square(final selected return state - 1.0); original _record normalizes following minus before; no double-add
source.FIT_probe_baseline_constraint: Only the selected 256 FIT-world input histories of TRAIN (24 groups) are permitted to estimate baseline; frozen midpoint of observed fifth resulting states must be independent of gate and group. Training and heldout receive the same scalar without using hidden labels.
source.initial_freeze_technical_clarification: This clarification before implementation removes an impossible nonmatching-probe-control assumption from the first prereg draft. Original freeze ancestor retained; current JSON Git blob governs.

methods.FIT_only_probe_calibration: Compute the no-q fifth-probe following-state offset by averaging actually selected FIT factual fifth-probe measurements across the balanced q=+1/-1 cohort. Only the decoded resulting states (probe_state + encoded selected delta) enter this fit-only calibration; no hidden q sign, generator baseline constant, evaluation metadata or CAL/OOD observations. Freeze the scalar before training or any CAL/OOD score.
methods.observational_ceiling: Fixed deterministic public cue-tag extractor plus FIT-only probe-offset estimator applied to selected fifth and B observed effects; bound feasibility, never label this trained neural learning.
methods.init_seed_provenance: base seed plus stable disjoint arm offsets
methods.learning: Cross entropy on actually selected return-derived paired choice labels; probe-centered observation head explicitly observes decoded following-minus-FIT-frozen-offset, B head reads public state tag plus selected physical effect; interaction gate trainable
ablations: swap B across paired opposite-gate worlds

preregistered_score.if_one_seed_fails: Preserve NO-GO; do not alter loss, seed or source and retry consumed CAL/OOD
preregistered_score.if_reference_fails: SOURCE_VALIDITY_FAIL; stop before training/scoring; do not assert scientific result
preregistered_score.cross_os: All exact categorical decisions and frozen high-level judgments must agree across Windows/Ubuntu for reproducibility PASS

qualification: Mandatory full unchanged G4 Windows+Ubuntu, G5 Native TTT Windows+Ubuntu and G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu at exact final SHA, original artifact digests and per-decision parity before acceptance
